chapters.title: Not about who has the idea

transcript_chunks.text: mark zuckerberg became a billionaire at the age of 23 by creating one of the biggest social media platforms in the world facebook today we're gonna be taking a look at our top five biggest takeaways from the movie the social

network just one thing before we start if you could please leave us a like and subscribe would really appreciate it let's go ahead hop right into it and number one we have persistency plays a huge part in your success oftentimes your first idea in business

really never turns out to be your best idea and that's it was exactly the case with mark his first idea in college was face mash an online service that pretty much allowed you to judge and compare the attractiveness of your fellow

classmates and that idea even though it does sound like early tinder it got him in a lot of trouble the site ended up getting pulled down by harvard themselves as well as it led him in academic probation but even though that idea was a failure

it led him ultimately to facebook which allowed people to pretty much connect with others network and potentially even find a dating partner throughout the creation of facebook mark has to deal with a multitude of problems while

growing his business such as how to spread awareness for the actual business itself so that way he could increase his user base getting investors to actually fund the amount of new users he was getting and actually hire employees and then finally

dealing with the amount of long hours and workload that he was having to put on himself to actually improve and perfect the product to become what it is now today and that just shows you that you have to be really persistent and passionate

about what you're doing because it doesn't matter what you're actually working on or what you're trying to achieve you're gonna have to deal with problems and obstacles and ultimately working hard and being persistent is

what's going to get you through them at number two it's not about who has the idea it's about who can execute on the idea in the movie there's a set of twins called the winklevoss twins who had similar desires and ambitions as mark

zuckerberg to create a social platform and they wanted to create something very similar to facebook called connect you but the problem was is even though they had some similar ideas and a great idea they didn't actually have the skills

necessary to actually make their dreams a reality so what they ended up doing was trying to hire mark on to actually execute on the idea there was some angst between the two the partnership never ended up working out and so mark ended

up creating the facebook himself and pretty much that just the more of the story behind this is is that yes you can have a great idea but if you don't have the actual skills or the team behind you to actually build it it'll just stay an

idea and it won't make it a reality although the winklevoss twins did not have the team to actually execute on the idea in 2008 they did get a nice settlement of 65 million dollars pretty much saying that hey mark stole our idea

and we didn't get anything for it so they did get a nice settlement out of it at number three we have not getting what you want can sometimes be a blessing and in the beginning of the movie mark gets broken up with by his girlfriend and

angrily goes home and creates face mash and although this was actually proven false because he didn't actually have a girlfriend that led him to the creation of that but there's a great theme to it and it's a theme that i find very

consistent with in my life and that is when one door closes another one opens up often times when we have a journey that ends or you feel like you've failed or just concludes a lot of times you're left kind of like remorseful and upset

that it didn't really go the way you wanted to but oftentimes those times are actually the things that lead you to that bigger plan or that next best thing that's actually just getting ready to happen to you and i have found that very

often my life i've had business businesses fail and that has led me to this current opportunity that i'm literally working on right now the school of hard knocks and if it wasn't for those failures i wouldn't be where i am today working on something that i

truly love and that's something that is very applicable in my life and it's probably applicable in yours too at number four we have you can't be ultra successful without having a few enemies and throughout the movie mark definitely

did create a few enemies and even to this day he's actively creating enemies for himself but that's just really what comes with success in creating something to massive scale and that is you can't please everyone at the end of the day so

whatever journey you're going through or whatever journey you're really even on right now you're gonna have those people that are gonna be naysayers they don't believe in you and quite frankly they just don't even care about you

but it's really that inner circle and that self belief in yourself that's going to get you to where you want to go and then it's really just a realization that hey if people are hating on me i'm probably doing something right at number five and

this is a big one and honestly one that really surprised me that this even really needs to be talked about and that is to lawyer up in the movie eduardo sovereign gets his shares deluded by pretty much honestly negligence on his part of not really

realizing what was going on he kind of blindly signs papers end up leading to the dilution of his shares and ultimately ownership within facebook and although of course later on he did get his own settlement of an undisclosed

amount if i had to guess probably somewhere in the billions but really if you're in something that has the amount of scale as facebook or you're going into a business partnership or you're signing off on an asset or really you're

just doing anything that has anything to do with you know your shares ownership you should get a lawyer like for someone to be so brilliant and someone to be so smart he's literally going to harvard you should really be careful you just have to be careful even

if someone says they're your friend or you've known them for a long time when it comes to something such as business you really have to put friends and business aside and ultimately just look out for yourself and do the due

diligence of getting a lawyer and making sure that you're not signing off on something that could ultimately lead to your demise so those are my five takeaways that i got from the social network if you haven't seen that movie i

highly recommend you do there's some awesome acting and honestly just a really cool story line to see how facebook really came into fruition but yeah that's gonna be it for me today guys hope hopefully you guys enjoyed if
you guys did please give us a like and subscribe we'd really appreciate that i'll catch you guys in the next one
